set.body:
From the S3c run (docs/reviews/2026-10-24-s3c-source-identity-run.md, cb803e0c5). A description of a person who is not on screen can never be linked or hinted: ADR 0027 section 4's model input and the section 7 universe offer a mention only the people listed in its overlapping and adjacent rows. In the body case, word 276 (row 575, a noun describing the dead woman) is spoken while rows 574-576 list only Sherlock and John, so Jennifer Wilson was never a candidate; her nearest listing is row 579.
Acceptance: an ADR decision (owner, SD5) on an off-screen candidate rule, for example candidates from the scene's admitted identity classes or a time window wider than adjacent rows, with a court showing it cannot license deixis (hints only), or a decision to wait for tracks (bd-01M5PYJ7237CQAGMY0GC7ESZM1). Consumer: S3d (bd-01M5MT3DRFC5PY4BEBBVGVD168).
set.title: [evidence-binding] Off-screen candidates for descriptions of absent people
